gmail.subject: Payments webhook - staging deployment needed
gmail.body: Hi Amit, I need the staging queue configured for Payments webhook testing. Can someone from infra confirm whether the staging queue is ready?

gmail.subject: Re: Payments webhook - staging deployment needed
gmail.body: Rahul, infrastructure deployment for the staging queue is still pending. We're waiting on the security review before we can deploy. Should be done by end of week.

gmail.subject: Q3 Campaign - creative delay
gmail.body: Sneha, we need to discuss pushing the campaign launch. Creative assets for the hero section and social templates are still incomplete. Can we move launch to Monday next week?

gmail.subject: Decision needed: async processing for Payments notifications
gmail.body: We agreed to use asynchronous processing for the Payments notification workflow. This will improve reliability and decouple the webhook handler from downstream services.

gmail.subject: Welcome to Nexora — onboarding checklist
gmail.body: Welcome aboard! I'll take ownership of the onboarding checklist for you. Day 1: HR orientation at 10am. Day 2: Engineering team intro. Please complete the compliance training.

slack.message: Starting work on the webhook retry logic for Payments. Should be straightforward.
I've finished the retry logic but deployment is still blocked. Can't push to staging without infra.
Staging queue deployment is complete. Rahul, you should be unblocked now.
Webhook retry logic deployed and tested. PR merged. Payments webhook reliability is done.
Q3 brand campaign creative assets are behind schedule. Design team hasn't delivered the hero banners.
Let's push the campaign launch to Monday. Design is still working on the hero banners.
Starting scoping for the analytics dashboard — real-time metrics, user funnels, retention charts.
Product team is planning a customer analytics portal with funnel analysis and retention views. Overlapping with what engineering might be building?
Didn't realize Product was also building analytics dashboards. We should sync to avoid duplicate work.
Proposal: use asynchronous processing for the Payments notification workflow instead of sync calls.
API Gateway upgrade is at risk — performance tests failing on the new routing layer.
Found the routing bottleneck — connection pool misconfiguration. Fix deployed.
Only I have access to the legacy payment processor config.
Another question about the payment processor — I'm the only one who knows this system.
We need to document the payment processor setup. Rahul is a single point of failure here.

meetings.transcript: Engineering standup. Rahul: Payments webhook is blocked on infrastructure deployment. Amit: Security review is the gating item. Vikram: This puts the launch timeline at risk.
Campaign planning meeting. Decision: launch moved from Thursday to Monday due to incomplete creative assets. Ananya to prioritize hero banner delivery by Friday.
Cross-team sync on analytics. Identified overlap between Engineering's Analytics Dashboard and Product's Customer Analytics Portal. Agreed to consolidate requirements.
Architecture review. Decision confirmed: Payments notifications will use async message queue processing. Rahul to implement. Target: next sprint.
Onboarding session for Kamala Sinha. Covered company policies, tools access, and team introductions. New hire assigned to Platform team under Engineering.
